snippet.title: Eternal Palace Sakura - Official Demo Launch Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Demo Launch Trailer for Eternal Palace Sakura, an anime action hack-and-slash dungeon crawler developed by Denneko Yuugi. Players will sharpen their blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace! Eternal Palace Sakura is launching in Fall 2026 for PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
